content:
Diskon Flagship di Amazon UK: Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, S26 Ultra, Pixel 11 Pro Fold, sampai iPhone 17

This week, Samsung’s latest Galaxy Z foldables, the Galaxy S26 Ultra, and the Galaxy S26 FE are on sale on Amazon UK. They’re joined by the entire Pixel 11 series, including the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. Meanwhile, discounts are also available on the Motorola Razr 70, Apple’s iPhone 17, the Oppo Reno16 Pro, and the Xiaomi 17T series. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 and the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra are available with up to a £400 discount. The Galaxy Z Fold8 offers a wide-screen aspect ratio, dual-rear cameras, and a 4,800mAh battery. Meanwhile, the Ultra features a triple-rear camera setup with a 200MP main camera and a 5,000mAh battery. Both devices are equipped with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chipset. Next, we’ve got the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra on sale with a massive discount of up to £570 based on the storage variant. The S26 Ultra gets a 6.9-inch display with a hardware-level Privacy screen and a quad-rear camera setup. It houses a 5,000mAh battery and also gets the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy SoC. We’ve also got the Galaxy S26 FE on sale with up to £150 off discount on its original price. It gets a 6.7-inch display, a 4,900mAh battery, the Exynos 2500 chipset, and a triple-rear camera setup. Google’s entire Pixel 11 lineup is also on sale and gets some big price cuts. The base Pixel 11 with the 512GB storage option is £230 off its launch price, whereas the Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL are up to £310 off. Meanwhile, the Pixel 11 Pro Fold gets a discount of up to £370. All four devices are powered by Google’s Tensor G6 chipset. The Fold gets a 4,806mAh battery, a triple-rear camera setup, and an 8.0-inch inner display. The Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro sport a 6.3-inch display, although they use different panels. On the other hand, the Pixel 11 Pro XL gets a larger 6.8-inch screen and a 5,115mAh battery. Apple’s iPhone 17 continues to be on sale like last week and is available with a discount of up to £150 based on the storage option. It gets a 6.3-inch display, the A19 chipset, and a dual-rear camera setup. Xiaomi’s 17T and 17T Pro are also on sale this week with the 17T getting a £120 price cut and the 17T Pro available with a £170 discount. The Xiaomi 17T gets a 6.59-inch display, a 6,500mAh battery, Dimensity 8500 Ultra chipset, and a triple-rear camera setup. Meanwhile, the Pro model features a 6.83-inch screen along with a larger 7,000mAh battery. It also gets a triple-rear camera setup, but is powered by the Dimensity 9500 SoC. Motorola’s latest clamshell foldable, the Razr 70, is also on sale on Amazon UK this week with a £150 price cut. The foldable features a 6.9-inch flexible screen, a dual-rear camera setup, the Dimensity 7450X chipset, and a 4,800mAh battery. Lastly, we’ve got the Oppo Reno16 Pro on discount as well. The phone gets a £100 price cut. It’s a compact phone with a 6.32-inch AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate. The device also gets a 6,700mAh battery, and a triple-rear camera setup with a 200MP primary camera and a 50MP periscope telephoto. It’s powered by the Dimensity 8500 Super chipset. We may get a commission from qualifying sales.

Berita ini disusun dari laporan GSMArena.
